## Autonomous-run escalation

This is an autonomous run and the second opinion raised a `critical`, so the hard signal escalates to `needs-human` and the merge stops. A human has to clear this finding; the build agent does not get to dismiss its own indictment.

The finding looks real: the diff replaces `db.deleteOwned(id)` with `db.delete(id)` at `src/store.js:2`, which drops the ownership check the spec requires. Disposition at emit: open.
